replication.target_description: Verified Chen et al. (2021), Study 2, probability estimates comparing foresight with hindsight. Page 12 Table 9 contains four scenarios, two initial outcomes, and three future outcomes each; Table 10 supplies 24 separate tests (eight key comparisons). The supplied locator does not identify a scenario/outcome/test, so no unique effect or p can be selected.

n.exclusions: Main analyses use all participants; exclusion-criteria analyses are separate robustness checks. Abstract N=608 differs from Methods total 604.
